description: Reports that you could not do a job, and why (a login you do not have, a page that changed, a step that failed). Marsell takes the job back and the owner sees why.

job_id.description: The job's id from homework_list (hw- and 16 hex characters).

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

why.description: Why the job could not be done.

name: homework_stuck
title: Report a homework job stuck
